neighbours.label: 'execution' in the sense of carrying out a plan or strategy (business or team performance), plus the planning noun 'deliverables'; execution as killing, and plain synonyms like 'delivery', stay low
fire: The plan looked great on paper, but the execution fell apart in the final quarter.
Investors praised the company's disciplined execution of its expansion strategy.
Our consultants support clients from early design through execution and review.
The coach blamed poor execution rather than the game plan for the loss.
The contract lists the deliverables due at the end of each phase.
Good ideas are common; flawless execution is what separates winning firms.
She was hired to oversee the execution of the marketing campaign.
The vendor missed two deliverables and the client asked for a refund.
quiet: The plan looked great on paper, but the effort fell apart in the final quarter.
Investors praised the company's disciplined pursuit of its expansion strategy.
Our consultants support clients from early design through launch and review.
The general ordered the execution of the deserters at dawn.
The contract lists the payments due at the end of each phase.
The king's execution in the public square shocked the whole country.
She was hired to oversee the launch of the marketing campaign.
The vendor missed two meetings and the client asked for a refund.

notes: Card: top peaks ' execution' x9 and ' numbers' x10 in business/performance text, 'deliver-ables'. Probe: 'the execution was poor throughout the season' 0.805, 'technology and execution capabilities' 0.848, 'deliverables' 0.651, 'The numbers certainly bear that out' 0.326; 'the prisoner's execution' 0.067, code 'halts execution' 0.226, synonym 'the delivery was poor' 0.117. Near misses keep the business frame with a synonym, or use the killing sense.
